lanes.name: PHASER_SCENES
lanes.finding: BattleScene and globalScene own display objects, pipelines, cameras, effects and teardown; globalScene coupling is the primary migration risk.

lanes.name: RUST_PRESENTATION
lanes.finding: Typed presentation plans, settlement tombstones and snapshot persistence exist; no first-class semantic scene-delta schema exists.

lanes.name: LOGICAL_UI
lanes.finding: Rust owns exact battle navigation; startup, save, rewards, world, scenarios, terminal and lobby still lack Rust-native control DTO coverage.

lanes.name: SPRITE_ASSETS
lanes.finding: Sprite assets span local PNGs, generated atlas metadata and an immutable er-assets CDN pin; current validation is structural rather than semantic.

lanes.name: TEXT_ACCESSIBILITY
lanes.finding: Text styling is centralized, but RTL, locale-aware breaking and an accessible semantic canvas mirror are missing; hidden DOM inputs require strict noncanonical boundaries.

lanes.name: EFFECTS_SHINY_LAB
lanes.finding: Closed palette, surface and around registries plus seeded visual noise exist; mutable global effect and texture caches need renderer-generation ownership.

lanes.name: MODEL_3D
lanes.finding: No GLB/glTF assets or model pipeline exist; M10 needs a new validated intake, geometry/material limits, LOD and sprite fallback.

lanes.name: AUDIO
lanes.finding: BattleScene owns playback, caches and timers while co-op already treats cues as cosmetic; browser and iOS memory policies differ materially.

lanes.name: WGPU_PLATFORM
lanes.finding: No WebGPU/wgpu backend exists; current hosts are Phaser WebGL, Canvas2D utilities and Wasm JSON bridges.

lanes.name: DEVICE_LIFECYCLE
lanes.finding: Recovery fences, session pins and idempotent teardown exist; a GPU device-loss state machine and asset rebuild evidence are missing.

lanes.name: RENDERER_RELOAD
lanes.finding: Canonical snapshots and generation guards provide the transactional skeleton; renderer, shader and asset generations need an independent unified contract.

lanes.name: PERFORMANCE_SECURITY
lanes.finding: Benchmark and renderer-denylist primitives exist; M10 needs measured mobile classes, GPU instrumentation and accepted baseline artifacts.

freeze_blockers: No WebGPU dependency or host exists
No measured M10 performance baseline exists
